title: JustVugg/colibri
claim: JustVugg/colibri — Run GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) on a 25GB-RAM consumer machine — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, imme
why_good: Streams a 744B-param MoE model's experts from disk to run frontier-scale AI on a 25GB-RAM laptop (pure C, zero deps). If quality/latency hold, it removes the #1 barrier — VRAM & cloud cost — to private, offline frontier models. 20k★ / ~2k forks / 64 contributors in 26 days.
value: The local-inference runtime is the toll booth for 'frontier AI on your own hardware' — monetize via a managed/pro tier, on-prem enterprise licenses, and a fine-tune/model marketplace on top.
risk: Disk-streaming may be too slow for real workloads; llama.cpp / ollama could copy the technique and absorb it.

zh.claim: JustVugg/colibri —— 在 25GB 内存的消费级机器上跑 GLM-5.2(744B MoE):纯 C、零依赖、专家权重从磁盘流式加载。
zh.why_good: 把 744B 参数 MoE 模型的专家从磁盘流式加载,在 25GB 内存的笔记本上跑前沿级 AI(纯 C、零依赖);若质量/延迟撑得住,就干掉了最大障碍——显存和云成本。
zh.value: 本地推理运行时是「在自己硬件上跑前沿 AI」的收费闸口——靠托管/专业版、本地部署的企业授权变现。
zh.risk: 磁盘流式可能对真实负载太慢;llama.cpp / ollama 能照抄这个技巧并把它吸收掉。
zh.hook: 有真实预算的玩家在求「用自己的机器跑 744B 前沿模型」——A100 车主留言『求你救救我』——但今天只有 C 语言极客能开得动。
zh.does: 纯 C、零依赖引擎,靠从磁盘流式加载专家权重,在 25GB 内存机器上跑 GLM-5.2(744B MoE)。不到一个月 20k★、64 位贡献者,issue 区像研究组。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用:「在自己硬件上跑前沿模型」这个能力外面没有产品——没有安装器、没有 App、没有聊天界面、没有诚实的延迟预期。
zh.counter: Ollama/LM Studio 随时可以吸收磁盘流式这招;多卡机器也只有 1–7 tok/s,真的 25GB 笔记本是「每分钟几个 token」。窗口可能在体验成立之前就关上。
zh.differentiator: 不做引擎做包装:一键安装的「私有 GLM」桌面应用,面向数据不能出机器的人群(法律、医疗、无云环境),主打文档问答,延迟明说。
zh.consumer_angle: 完全离线、跑在你已有硬件上的 ChatGPT 级模型——给数据绝不能离开本机的人。

hook: Enthusiasts with real hardware budgets are begging to run frontier 744B models on their own machines — one A100 owner posted 'I hope you can rescue me' — but today only C hackers can drive it.
pick_reason: The project addresses a significant barrier in running large AI models on consumer hardware, showing strong potential for commercialization.
does: Pure-C, zero-dependency engine that runs GLM-5.2 (744B MoE) on a 25GB-RAM machine by streaming expert weights from disk. 20k★, 64 contributors and a research-grade issue tracker in under a month.

gap: Only geeks can use it: the capability (a frontier model on hardware you own) has no product around it — no installer, no app, no chat UI, no honest latency guidance.
counter: Ollama/LM Studio can absorb disk-streaming the week it proves out, and real-world speed is 1–7 tok/s on multi-GPU rigs — a true 25GB laptop gets tokens per minute. The consumer window may close before the UX is viable.
differentiator: Don't compete on the engine — package it: a one-click private-GLM desktop app for privacy-bound users (legal, medical, no-cloud environments), doc-QA as the killer use, honest about latency.
consumer_angle: Your own ChatGPT-class model, fully offline, on hardware you already own — for people whose data cannot leave the machine.
